hero.title: One Day. Six Executive Conversations. No Time Wasted.
hero.description: AIX Summit replaces the traditional multi-day, multi-track conference with a single, highly compressed schedule. The entire architecture of the day is designed to get the right people into closed-door rooms as quickly as possible, facilitate substantive exchange, and get them back to running their enterprises.

architecturalReasoning.title: Two Focused Roundtable Sessions
architecturalReasoning.desc: Instead of one block, the afternoon features two 90-minute roundtable sessions (75 mins discussion, 15 mins startup showcase).

architecturalReasoning.title: Integrated Startup Showcases
architecturalReasoning.desc: Startups present directly to the right people at the right moment. Each startup has 6 minutes in front of 15 executives who just spent 75 minutes on the problem it solves.

architecturalReasoning.title: The Networking Break Unites the Room
architecturalReasoning.desc: The 30-minute break between sessions brings attendees of both sessions together to network with each other and meet the startups at their booths.

architecturalReasoning.title: No Stage Synthesis
architecturalReasoning.desc: Rather than plenary read-outs, each table's key observations are captured anonymously and go directly into the published AIX Roundtable Signals report.
